cards.claim: An order must satisfy dated venue price, quantity and notional rules. A simulated fill does not prove exchange acceptance. Never round up through a risk limit.
A correct price direction can still lose after fees and adverse slippage. Trading results and AI operating costs are separate. Candles do not reveal the full execution path.
Account risk depends on stop distance and costs, not just position value. Independent code owns the 0.5% per-trade and 2.5% aggregate caps. Gaps can exceed planned losses.
Use only closed candles and reviewed outcomes available at the decision time. A close-derived decision cannot fill before the next candle opens. Never infer future outcomes from dates.
The fixed prior-20-bar breakout is a testable hypothesis, not a profitable fact. WAIT is permitted. Classification confidence is not a calibrated probability of profit.
Retain losing and winning examples. A small or selected sample cannot justify a rule. Compare a frozen candidate against controls on untouched periods; teacher approval cannot promote it.
